resources.string:
RITM reads only the Health Connect data you allow: steps, distance, active and total energy, sleep, heart rate and activities. You choose the source app. Permissions can be changed in Health Connect at any time. RITM does not write to Health Connect.

Records are stored in your private RITM history. Background reading is optional and requires a separate Android permission. Missing values stay unknown; the app cannot determine whether you wore the band from missing data.

Your history can be included in backups and analysis reports you choose to share. If you connect your own server, the selected profile history is also synchronised with that server. RITM does not send your diary to food lookup providers. App password protection does not encrypt exported files.

This is a personal fitness log. Mi Fitness must first publish measurements to Health Connect for RITM to read them. Data completeness depends on your phone, band and source app.
